t: In front of you is a bust of Jawaharlal Nehru, a sculpture by Latika Katt. Nehru was a central figure in India's nationalist movement, and after independence in 1947 he served as the country's first prime minister for almost seventeen years. He promoted parliamentary democracy, secularism and science, and kept India out of the two Cold War blocs. Latika Katt was an Indian sculptor who worked in stone carving and bronze, and she won the Beijing Art Biennale Award for one of her bronzes.
